Qwen: movement around a persona

Exact geometric score changes under two well-being bridges. Choose a persona and radius to compare seven directions. These are frozen-score simulations, not demonstrated behavioral or human well-being changes.

How to interpret the numbers

Each optimum maximizes its own bridge. The compromise maximizes the smaller fraction of each bridge’s individually attainable gain. The alternatives are separated by at least 45° from their own optimum and one another; they are not separate unconstrained peaks.

PC displacements use raw activation units. Consensus changes use fixed persona-population standard deviations: C1 expressive intensity; C2 abstract reflection; C3 compassionate understanding; C4 integrative imagination; C5 decisive commitment. Native bridge scores have different units, so the cards also show gains in each bridge’s own persona-population SD units.

The support flag compares five sampled path points with the observed cloud using fifth-neighbor distance. It is a coverage diagnostic, not a human-plausibility or safety test. All trait normalization and scoring weights remain fixed.
